title: Radial bar chart
description: Progress as concentric rings: activity rings, OKR completion, sales against quota. Each bar fills its ring up to its value over its max, on a tinted background track, with rounded ends; labels sit in the open part of the circle and a center text can sum things up. Hover a ring or use the arrow keys to read its value, max and progress.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: rounded
props.description: Rounded bar ends (default `true`)

props.name: labels
props.description: Labels before the start of the bars (default: when `sweep` leaves room for them)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: track
props.description: Background tracks behind the bars (default `true`)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: max
props.description: Value of a full bar for the data without `max` (default: the largest value)

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: data
props.description: Bars, from the outermost ring inward: a name, a value, an optional `max` and color

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the rings, as a fraction of a ring's slot (default 0.28)

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Angle where the bars start, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock (default 0)

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Radius of the innermost ring's inner edge, as a fraction of the outer radius (default 0.3)

props.name: labelContent
props.description: What a label shows: name, value, percent of the bar's max (default `["name", "value"]`)

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Big text in the center (e.g. the overall completion)

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Small text under `centerValue`

props.name: sweep
props.description: Angle of a full bar, degrees; 360 = full rings (default 270)

<script setup lang="ts">
// Activity rings: each bar has its own `max` (the goal), `sweep` 360 makes
// full rings and the center texts summarize them.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { RadialBarChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: { rings: ["Move", "Exercise", "Stand"], today: "of today’s goals" },
  zh: { rings: ["活动", "锻炼", "站立"], today: "今日目标" },
  ja: { rings: ["ムーブ", "エクササイズ", "スタンド"], today: "今日の目標" },
  fr: {
    rings: ["Bouger", "M’entraîner", "Me lever"],
    today: "des objectifs du jour",
  },
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const data = computed(() => [
  { name: text.value.rings[0], value: 420, max: 500, color: "#ef4444" },
  { name: text.value.rings[1], value: 24, max: 30, color: "#22c55e" },
  { name: text.value.rings[2], value: 9, max: 12, color: "#06b6d4" },
]);
</script>

<template>
  <RadialBarChart
    :data="data"
    :sweep="360"
    :label-content="['name', 'percent']"
    center-value="78 %"
    :center-label="text.today"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// Key results completion on one scale (`max` 100): the labels sit before
// the start of the bars, in the empty quarter left by the 270° sweep.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { RadialBarChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const OKR = {
  en: ["Revenue", "New customers", "Retention", "NPS", "Hiring"],
  zh: ["营收", "新客户", "留存率", "净推荐值", "招聘"],
  ja: ["売上", "新規顧客", "継続率", "NPS", "採用"],
  fr: [
    "Chiffre d’affaires",
    "Nouveaux clients",
    "Rétention",
    "NPS",
    "Recrutement",
  ],
};

const DONE = [92, 74, 61, 48, 35];

const { language } = useI18n();
const data = computed(() =>
  (OKR[language.value] ?? OKR.en).map((name, i) => ({ name, value: DONE[i] })),
);
const format = (value: number) => `${value} %`;
</script>

<template>
  <RadialBarChart
    :data="data"
    :max="100"
    :inner-radius="0.2"
    :format="format"
  />
</template>

activity.title: Activity rings
activity.description: Full rings (sweep={360}) for Move, Exercise and Stand, each against its own daily goal (max). Picking another day animates the rings; as there is no room for labels, the legend names the rings.

okr.title: OKR completion
okr.description: Key results in percent of their target (max={100}), labelled with their name and percent before the start of each bar; the average completion is written in the center.

quota.title: Sales against quota
quota.description: A half circle (sweep={180}, startAngle={-90}) takes half the height; each region has its own quota as max. labels={false} shows the legend instead, and the center gives the overall attainment.

styles.title: Shapes and styles
styles.description: sweep and startAngle set the shape of the rings, rounded the ends of the bars and track the background tracks.

savings-goals.title: Savings goals
savings-goals.description: Each pot has its own goal as max, and labelContent shows the name and the percent saved. onClick picks a goal: the line below gives the amount left and how many months the monthly transfer needs to reach it.

leaderboard.title: Season leaderboard
leaderboard.description: A RadioGroup ranks the players by goals or assists; the leader takes the outermost ring and the scale, and the podium gets gold, silver and bronze through each datum's color. renderTooltip adds the rank, the games played and the average per game.

uploads.title: File uploads
uploads.description: Full rings (sweep={360}) track four uploads, two at a time, with a setInterval that stops once everything is sent or on unmount; animation={false} keeps the bars in step with the fast updates. labels={false} lets the legend name the files, and only completed files are announced.

survey.title: Engagement survey
survey.description: Each statement's max is the number of people who answered it, so the bars show the share who agree. A Select reorders the rings by survey order or by score, percentFormat writes the percents, and renderTooltip gives the underlying counts.

basic.title: Activity rings
basic.description: Move, exercise and stand against their daily goals; pick a day of the week to animate the rings to its values.

RadialBarChartProps.data: Bars, from the outermost ring inward: a name, a value, an optional max and color
RadialBarChartProps.max: Value of a full bar for the data without max (the largest value by default)
RadialBarChartProps.innerRadius: Radius of the innermost ring's inner edge, as a fraction of the outer radius
RadialBarChartProps.startAngle: Angle where the bars start, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock
RadialBarChartProps.sweep: Angle of a full bar, in degrees (360 draws full rings)
RadialBarChartProps.gap: Gap between the rings, as a fraction of a ring's slot (0 to 0.9)
RadialBarChartProps.track: Draws the background tracks behind the bars
RadialBarChartProps.rounded: Rounds the ends of the bars
RadialBarChartProps.labels: Labels before the start of the bars, in the open part of the circle (on by default when the sweep leaves room, up to 300°)
RadialBarChartProps.labelContent: What a label shows: name, value and / or percent of the bar's max
RadialBarChartProps.centerValue: Big text in the center (e.g. the overall completion)

RadialBarDatum.name: Name shown in the label, the legend and the tooltip
RadialBarDatum.value: Value of the bar (negative values count as 0)
RadialBarDatum.color: Color (any CSS color, var(--x) included); taken from the palette when omitted
RadialBarDatum.max: Value of a full bar (e.g. a goal); the chart's max when omitted

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
